name: mirage
text: Because the betting wallet is the working capital for bets and bids that are meant to have an edge, and an IPO stock is a different kind of bet with no edge I can show. Putting it in the same pot means a bad month at Novig could force you to sell it, and a stock drop could leave the engine too small to bet properly. Also, your current records show the Vigilant subaccount is net down, so I'd not move more money around until that's understood. It's your call; I'm just saying keep them separate.
